import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette for fraud vs non-fraud
colors = {0: '#2ecc71', 1: '#e74c3c'}
fraud_labels = {0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'}

# Plot 1: Distribution of transaction amounts by fraud status
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for fraud_status in [0, 1]:
    subset = df[df['is_fraud'] == fraud_status]
    ax1.hist(subset['amount'], bins=30, alpha=0.6, 
             label=fraud_labels[fraud_status], color=colors[fraud_status])
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend()

# Plot 2: Fraud rate by transaction type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
fraud_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'] = fraud_by_type['sum'] / fraud_by_type['count'] * 100
fraud_by_type = fraud_by_type.sort_values('fraud_rate', ascending=True)

bars = ax2.barh(fraud_by_type.index, fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'], color='#3498db', edgecolor='navy')
ax2.set_xlabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(fraud_by_type.iterrows()):
    ax2.text(row['fraud_rate'] + 0.5, i, f'{row["fraud_rate"]:.1f}%', va='center', fontsize=10)

# Plot 3: Fraud distribution by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_fraud = df.groupby(['hour_of_day', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
hourly_fraud.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=[colors[0], colors[1]], width=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Transactions by Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
ax3.legend([fraud_labels[0], fraud_labels[1]], title='Status')
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=8)

# Plot 4: Box plot of amounts by transaction type and fraud status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['Fraud Status'] = df['is_fraud'].map(fraud_labels)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='Fraud Status',
            palette=[colors[0], colors[1]], ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amounts by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12)
ax4.legend(title='Status')

# Add summary statistics as text
total_transactions = len(df)
total_fraud = df['is_fraud'].sum()
fraud_rate = (total_fraud / total_transactions) * 100
summary_text = f'Total Transactions: {total_transactions}\nFraud Cases: {total_fraud}\nOverall Fraud Rate: {fraud_rate:.2f}%'
fig.text(0.02, 0.02, summary_text, fontsize=10, verticalalignment='bottom',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.05, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
